pooledEncouragements.text: Ngati simukupanga zolakwika, zimatanthauza kuti zili zosavuta kwambiri kwa inu—mwina muyenera kuyesa ku Dulani kupita patsogolo!
Musadandaule ngati ziganizo nthawi zina zili zitali kwambiri, nenani zimene mungathe ndipo mverani mosamalitsa zitsanzo.
Mukamiona ngati masewera, idzamva yopweteka pang'ono ndipo mudzasangalala kwambiri.
Kumbukirani kuti kuphunzira kumabwera m'masitepe, choncho musadandaule ngati mwaiwala mawu amene munkanena kale, izi ndi zachibadwa.
Mwayika khama lalikulu kuti mufike pano, ndikukondweranani nanu. Pitirizani!
Kumbukirani kuti muyenera kulankhula mokweza pa mpata—ngakhale ngati simungathe kunena chiganizo chonse, nenani mawu ambiri momwe mungathere.
Ngati mukumva kutopa, imeneyi ndi chizindikiro chabwino kuti muli mu gawo lofunika la 10%, choncho pitirizani kukankha—ubongo wanu ungathe kuchita zambiri kuposa momwe mukuganizira.
Kodi mukukumbukira pamene ndinakuuzani za kuopsa kwa kufuna zonse zangwiro? Musayese kukhala wangwiro, yesani kukhala wachangu, ndipo mudzachita bwino kwambiri.
Mukuchita bwino kwambiri—inde, ndikudziwa kuti mukufuna kuchita zolakwika zochepa, koma khama limene mukuyika ndi limene limabweretsa zotsatira, choncho mukukhala mukuchita bwino kwambiri.
Ngati ziganizo sizinakhale zitali kwambiri kwa nthawi yaitali, sitikukukankhani mokwanira, ndipo muyenera kuyesa ku Dulani kupita ku chinthu chotsatira chatsopano.
Ndikofunika kusewera ndi chilankhulo, kuchisangalatsa, choncho musadzitengere mozama kwambiri, ndipo yesani kuseka zinthu zikalakwika—zikamveka zosangalatsa kwambiri, mudzapita mwachangu.
Simudzaiwala kotheratu mawu aliwonse, amangomira pansi pa ulamuliro wanu wazindikiridwe. Mukamva pomwe, adzabwerera kwa inu, choncho musadandaule.
Ichi mwina ndi chiphunzitso chovuta kwambiri cha ubongo padziko, choncho mukuchita bwino kwambiri ndipo muli oyenera kupambana konse kwa kuphunzira chilankhulo kumene mudzapeza.
Kumbukirani kulankhula mokweza, ndipo ngati magawo osavuta akukubosetsani pang'ono, yesani kulankhula ndi mawu osangalatsa.

Ubongo ungathe kudzimanganso ndi kudzikonzanso nthawi zonse, ngakhale utavulazidwa kwambiri—zimatanthauza kuti ubongo wanu ungathe kulimbitsa chilichonse chimene tingauponyere. Khulupirirani nokha, kapena kumene, khulupirirani ubongo wanu.
Ndipo kumbukirani kuti ubongo wanu uli ndi ma neurons ambiri monga nyenyezi zimene zili mu galaxy—ubongo wanu ndiwo chinthu chovuta kwambiri m'chilengedwe chonse.
Ngati zina mwa ziganizo zikumveka zosavuta kwambiri pano, yesani kunena mawu owonjezera pa mpata—khalani odzilengedza, pitilizani kulankhula mpaka mutamva mawu oyamba achitsanzo.
Kodi mukudziwa kufunika kotenga izi ngati masewera? Nthawi yotsatira mukamapeza chiganizo chitali bwino, dzipatseni mphatso yabwino kwambiri, chinthu chimene mumakonda. Muyenera ndithu.
Pano, muyenera kukhala mukudzilankhula nokha m'chilankhulo chanu chatsopano mphindi zisanu tsiku lililonse—mukachita izi, mudzakhala bwino kwambiri mofulumira.
Mukugwira ntchito molimbika kwambiri kuphunzira, ndipo mwafika kutali, ndinu ngwazi yeniyeni. Muyenera kunyadira kwambiri.

Nthawi yopumula pang'ono. Kumva kukwiya kumene pamene mawu ali pamjingo pa lilime lanu? Ndiko ubongo wanu ukukuuzani kuti watsala pang'ono kumaliza kumanga chikumbukiro chimenecho. Muli pafupi kuposa momwe mukuganizira. Chabwino, tibwerere—ndipo kumbukirani, kukwiya ndi chizindikiro chabwino!

Tiyeni tipume kanthawi. Kumbukirani, nthawi iliyonse mukulankhula mokweza, mukugwiritsa ntchito ma circuits a ubongo owonjezera amene kuwerenga ndi kulemba sizingathe kufika. Pakamwa panu pakuchita ntchito yofunika kwa ubongo wanu panopa. Ndipo tsopano tiyeni tibwezeretse pakamwa pamenepo ku ntchito.

Ubongo wanu ukuyenera kupuma masekondi ochepa. Ngati mukumva kukoma mtima kwa inu nokha lero, chabwino kwambiri—mudzaphunzira mwachangu. Ngati mukudzitsutsa, yesani kudzithandiza momwe mungahandizire mwana wamantha amene akuyesetsa kwambiri. Tsopano, khalani okoma mtima kwa inu nokha ndipo pitirizani.

Kupuma kochepa pamene ma synapses anu akutsatira. Ubongo wanu uli ndi njira zambiri zothekera kuposa ma atoms amene ali mu chilengedwe chonse (masamu ake ndi odabwitsa koma osangalatsa). Ubongo wanu ungathe ndithu kuthana ndi njira iyi yophunzirira. Mukhulupirireni. Tsopano tiyeni timpatsire zina zoti azigwire nazo ntchito.

Pumani pang'ono. Nthawi zija zachete pamene simungathe kukumbukira mawu? Khalani momwemo. Musachite mantha. Chinachake chidzabwera, ndipo nthawi iliyonse chimabwera, mumakhala olimba mtima. Chabwino, tibwerere ku masewera tsopano.

Nthawi yolimbikitsidwa pang'ono. Ngati mawu amveka osadziwika, musadandaule—ubongo wanu ukuwalemba syllable ndi syllable, phokoso ndi phokoso, ngakhale simukudziwa. Tsiku lina adzangogwera m'malo. Pano pake, pitirizani kupita patsogolo.

Tiyeni tipume pang'ono. Kumbukirani, ngakhale maganizo ovuta amadutsa mu ubongo wanu mu masekondi 90 okha ngati muwalekereza. Zindikirani kukwiya, kenako bwezeretsani maganizo anu ku funso lotsatira. Ndi zokhazo zomwe muyenera kuchita. Polankhula za zimenezi—funso lotsatira lili pano.

Ganizo lachangu pamene mukupuma. Simukuphunzira mawu okha—mukumanga mapangidwe amene amakhathamiranana m'njira zatsopano. Mapangidwe ambiri mukasonkhanitsa, ziganizo zambiri zimabwera ngati zamatsenga. Tiyeni tipite kukasonkhanitsa zina panopa.

Nazi chinthu chofunika kudziwa. Kupuma ndi gawo la njirayi, osati kuchoka pa njirayi. Ubongo wanu umapitiriza kugwira ntchito pa zinthuzi pamene mukuchita zinthu zina. Choncho ngati mukufuna kusiya, siyani mopanda kumva kupezeka. Koma ngati muli okonzeka kupitiriza—tiyeni tipitirize!

Kupuma kwina kochepa. Chiganizo chilichonse chimene mukunena chili ngati push-up ya ubongo wanu. Zingamveke zochepa, koma mukukhala olimba ndi chiganizo chilichonse. Ndipo tsopano ndi nthawi ya ma push-ups ena.

Tiyeni tipume kanthawi. Ngati mukudzikankhira ndipo zikumveka zovuta, ichi si chizindikiro kuti china chake chalakwika—ndiye gawo la 10%, pamene kuphunzira kwabwino kwambiri kumachitika. Zosavuta sizibweretsa zotsatira. Zovuta zimabweretsa zotsatira. Ndipo mukuchita zovuta panopa, choncho zachitika bwino. Ndipo tsopano, tibwerere kuyesetsa.

Kupuma kwachangu kwa ma neurons anu. Pamene munanena chinachake tsopano ndipo munamva mtundu wosiyana kuchokera ku chitsanzo, ubongo wanu unazindikira kusiyana kwake. Kuzindikira kumene? Ndiko kuphunzira kumene kukuchitika nthawi yeniyeniyo. Choncho musamve bwino—mumve onyadira. Ndipo tsopano tiyeni tipatse ubongo wanu mwayi wina wozindikira kusiyana.

Nthawi yopuma mpweya. Mukudziwa momwe olankhula chilankhulo choyamba amalankhulira mwachangu? Ndi chifukwa chakuti agwirizanitsa mawu pamodzi m'magulu. Ndiye zenizeni zimene mukumanga panopa, gawo ndi gawo. Posachedwa, zidzayendanso kuchokera kwa inu. Chabwino, tibwerere kumanga.

Nazi ganizo lotonthoza. Simukuyenera kukumbukira zonse mwangwiro panopa. Kubwerezabwereza ndi mpata kumatanthauza kuti tidzapitiriza kubweretsa mawu mpaka atamatire. Ntchito yanu yokha ndi kupitiriza kupita patsogolo. Choncho tiyeni tipitirize kuyenda.

Kupuma pang'ono kwa inu. Ngati mwakhala mukuchita kwa kanthawi ndipo ubongo wanu ukumva kutopa, ngakhale pang'ono kupweteka—zikomo kwambiri, mukuchita ntchito yeniyeni ya ubongo. Izi ndiye momwe kumanga ma synapses atsopano kumamvekera. Pumani kanthawi, kenako tiyeni timange zina.

Nthawi yopuma mpweya pang'ono. Mawu amene ali mumutu mwanu omwe akuti muyenera kuchita bwino kuposa panopa? Akulakwitsa. Akukuyerekeza ndi wophunzira wangwiro wongoyerekeza amene alibe. Mukuchita bwino kwambiri. Uzani mawuwo akhale chete, ndipo pitirizani.

Nthawi yopuma. Kumbukirani, simukuyesetsa kuti chiganizo chilichonse chikhale changwiro—mukuyesetsa kuchita mayesero ambiri momwe mungathere. Liwiro limapambana kuposa kulongosoka panopa. Kulongosoka kumabwera mtsogolo, pafupifupi kokha. Choncho khalani achangu, khalani omasuka, ndipo tiyeni tipite.

Tiyeni time pano. Mawu aliwonse amene mukuphunzira ali ndi zikwi zikwi za ma connexions amene akumangidwa mozungulira—maphokoso, matanthauzo, maganizo, zomwe zikuchitika. Simukukumbukira kokha, mukukulitsa kamangidwe katsopano mu ubongo wanu. Ndiye zodabwitsa zenizeni. Tsopano tiyeni tionjezere.

Nthawi ya ganizo. Ngati mukupeza kuti ziganizo zitali zikukulemetsani, zimenezi ndi bwino—nenani mawu aliwonse amene mungathe kupeza. Ngakhale mawu awiri kapena atatu ndi angwiro. Ubongo wanu umamva zotsalazo ndipo umawasungira mtsogolo. Chabwino, tiyeni tiyeserenso.

Nazi nthawi yopuma mpweya. Masiku ena mawu amayenda mosavuta; masiku ena amawoneka ngati akubisala. Ndiye momwe ubongo umagwirira ntchito—mphamvu imatulukanso. Khalani ofatsa kwa inu nokha masiku ovuta. Mukupitiriza kuphunzira, ngakhale simukumvera choncho. Chabwino, tipite patsogolo.

Nthawi ya kupuma kochepa. Mwina simukudziwa, koma nthawi iliyonse mukulumphira ndi kunena chinachake—chilichonse—musanakonzekere, mukuphunzitsa nokha kukhala olimba mtima. Kulimba mtima ndi khasu lomwe. Tiyeni tiligwiritse ntchito pang'ono panopa.

Tiyeni titenge sekonde. Tsopano, cholinga si kumveka ngati buku la sukulu. Cholinga ndi kulankhulana. Olankhula chilankhulo choyamba amapunthwa, amasintha njira pakati pa chiganizo, amaiwala mawu nthawi zonse. Inunso munaloledwa kutero, chabwino? Tsopano, tinali pati?

Nazi chinthu chokumbukira. Mukamva mawu achitsanzo mutanena, mverani ngati mukumva nyimbo—mulolezeni akufikeni, musawafufuze. Ubongo wanu umatenga zambiri pamene muli opuma kuposa pamene mukuyesetsa kwambiri. Bwinobwino mopuma, ndiye—tiyeni tipite.

Nthawi ya kupuma pang'ono. Chinthu chimene munali pafupi kudziwa mawuwo, kenako munamva ndipo munaganiza 'Inde ndi zimenezo!'? Ndiko ubongo wanu akuyika zidutswa zomaliza pamalo awo. Nthawi zimenezi ndi mzere womaliza wa chikumbukiro chimene chikumangidwa. Tsopano tiyeni tikamange zikumbukiro zina.

Imani kanthawi. Nazi ganizo lodabwitsa—simuli munthu yemweyo amene munali mutayamba phunziroli. Ndithu—ubongo wanu wasintha kale. Maulumikizano atsopano alipo tsopano amene analibe kale. Ngakhale zimamveka ngati ndikukupatsani mawu olimbikitsa opanda pake, ndi sayansi ya ubongo yokha basi. Zodabwitsa kwambiri, si choncho? Ndipo tsopano tibwerere ku ntchito yodabwitsayi.

Kupuma kochepa panopa. Ngati ungwiro ukukukusumani kuti muyenera kuchita zonse bwino musanapite patsogolo—musamvere. Ungwiro ndi mdani wa kuphunzira chilankhulo. Munthu amene amapanga zolakwika zana nthawi zonse amapambana munthu amene amayesetsa mosamala makumi khumi. Ndipo tsopano tiyeni tikachite zolakwika zina.

Nthawi ya ganizo lina lachangu. Mukudziwa momwe amasewera amalankhulira za kukhala 'mu Malo Okonzeka'? Ndiye mawu ena a kuika maganizo. Mukakhala ndi maganizo onse pa mafunso, palibe malo a kudandaula kapena kudzitsutsa. Yesani kukhala m'malo amenewo panopa. Funso lotsatira lili pano.

Tiyeni tipume sekonde. Kulankhula mokweza kungamveke kuchilendo, makamaka ngati wina angakumveni. Koma manyazi ochepawo ndi mtengo wochepa pa zimene mukupeza. Mawu aliwonse amene mukulankhula amalimbitsa ma circuits amene kuphunzira mwakachetechete sikungafike. Choncho pitirizani kulankhula, ndipo pitirizani kukhala abwino pa izi.

Kupuma kanthawi kwa inu. Ubongo wanu ukuchita chinthu chodabwitsa panopa—ukutenga dongosolo la maphokoso ndi matanthauza lachilendelende ndipo ukupanga kuti likhale lanu. Ichi ndi chimodzi mwa zinthu zovuta kwambiri zimene ubongo wa munthu ungathe kuchita. Ndipo wanu ukuchita. Panopa penipeni. Choncho tiyeni timupatse funso lina nthawi yomweyo.

Nazi chinthu: mudzakhala wolankhula chilankhulo ichi. Osati chifukwa ndinu apadera kapena aluso, koma chifukwa mukuchita ntchitoyi, ndipo ntchito nthawi zonse imabweretsa zotsatira. Si funso la ngati. Koma liti. Tiyeni tichite kuti zikhale posachedwa m'malo mwa mochedwa mwa kupitiriza panopa.

orderedEncouragements.text: Tsopano, chimene mukuchita pano ndi ntchito yovuta kwambiri kwa ubongo—ndi momwe umakuphunzitsani mofulumira—choncho nthawi zina, ndidzakupatsani mpumulo wochepa ndi kukuuzani zinthu za ulendo uwu zimene zidzakuthandizani kupambana. Choyamba, kodi munadziwa kuti ubongo wanu uli ndi ma neurons pafupifupi 100 biliyoni? Ndi pafupifupi nyenyezi zomwe zili mu galaxy yathu. Chilichonse chimene anakuuzani kusukulu, ubongo wanu ndi wodabwitsa—choncho muyenera kukhulupirira luso la ubongo wanu kuphunzira zilankhulo. Mabongo onse ndi abwino kwambiri pa kuphunzira pamene apatsidwa ntchito yoyenera, ndipo ndidzakupatsani ntchito yoyenera. Tiyeni tipitirize. Aa, ndipo ngati mukuchita zolakwika nthawi zina, zili bwino—ndi zabwino, kwenikweni—zolakwika zimakuthandizani kuphunzira, ndipo ndidzakuuzani zambiri za izi pambuyo pake. Koma chonde pitirizani kupanga zolakwika!

Nthawi ya mpumulo wina wochepa. Tsopano, ndi zodabwitsa kuti ubongo wanu uli ndi ma neurons ambiri monga nyenyezi mu galaxy—koma ndi kofunika kwambiri momwe ma neurons amenewo amalumikizirana. Ndi malumikizidwe amene amapanga njira zonse zosiyanasiyana za zizindikiro kupyola mu ubongo. Si kosavuta kuyeza, koma limavomerezedwa kuti pa chiwerengero, neuron iliyonse ili ndi malumikizidwe pafupifupi ZIKWI ZISANU NDI ZIWIRI ndi ma neurons ena. Choncho chizindikiro chikapyola mu ubongo wanu, chili ndi zosankha zikwi zisanu ndi ziwiri pa sitepe iliyonse. Pambuyo pa masitepe ochepa okha, chiwerengero cha njira zomwe chikanatha kutenga chimakhala chachikulu kwambiri—kuposa chiwerengero cha ma atom mu chilengedwe. Ndi momwe ubongo wanu ulili wodabwitsa kwambiri, ndi chifukwa chake udzakuphunzitsani chilankhulo chatsopano. Ndipo pali njira yomwe tikatenga, yotchedwa lamulo la 10%, yomwe imathandiza kuti zonse zichitike—ndi yofunika kwambiri, ndipo ndidzakuuzani zambiri pambuyo pake.

Kodi ubongo wanu ukumva bwanji? Kodi ukufunika mpumulo? Ngati zinakudabwitsani kuti ubongo wanu uli ndi ma neurons 100 biliyoni ndi njira zambiri za zizindikiro kuposa ma atom mu chilengedwe, pali chinthu china chimodzi chokha chimene mukuyenera kudziwa. Malumikizidwe pakati pa ma neurons anu—timawatcha synapses—amasintha nthawi zonse. Timapanga ma synapses atsopano nthawi zonse, tikachita chinthu chatsopano chilichonse—ubongo umadzimanga yekha nthawi ndi nthawi. Panopa, pamene mukumvera izi, ubongo wanu ukumanga ma synapses atsopano. Chiganizo chilichonse chimene mungathe kunena mu chilankhulo chanu chatsopano, ubongo wanu ukumanga ma synapses atsopano. Ubongo wanu si wofanana ndi kompyuta yamphamvu kwambiri padziko—umadzipanga yekha nthawi zonse, ndipo ndiwo mphamvu yake yapadera. Luso lanu lenileni lophunzira ndi lopitirira chilichonse chimene anakuuzanicho, ndipo njira imodzi yofunika kwambiri imene ubongo wanu umaphunzira ndi kupanga zolakwika zambiri—zolakwika zimakuthandizani kupita mwachangu, choncho ndikukhulupirira kuti mukupanga zambiri—ndipo sindinaiwale kuti ndinalonjeza kuti ndidzakuuzani momwe zikukuthandizani pambuyo pake.

Choncho, zimatanthauza chiyani kwa inu kuti ubongo wanu umasintha nthawi zonse? Anthu akuyamba kumvetsetsa izi, chifukwa cha kuphunzira neuroplasticity—yomwe inavomerezedwa m'zaka makumi awiri apitazo. Mfundo yofunika kwa inu ndi yakuti ubongo wanu ungathe kuphunzitsidwa. Ndi chida chopereka tanthauzo ku zinthu, ndipo siyembekezera kugwira ntchito. Cholowa chilichonse chimene muperekedza ku ubongo wanu, chiyesa kupeza tanthauzo, ndipo nthawi zambiri chimapambana. Mungofunikira kupeza cholowa choyenera, ndipo ndi chimene tachita kwa inu ndi mphunzitsi wodziyendetsera ameneyu. Ponena za kulankhula, ndidzakuuzani zinthu zina zodabwitsa za momwe ubongo wanu ungaphunzitsidwire, kuphatikiza lamulo lofunika kwambiri la 10%, mukaphunzira pang'ono zambiri.

Konzekerani kudabwa. Tikhoza kutenga zambiri kuchokera ku makamera awiri a kanema, kuzisandutsa ku feed ya digito, kutumiza feed ya digitoyo ku chibandiko pa mphumi kapena lilime la munthu amene wataya kuona kwake—ndipo pa nthawi yaitali (milungu kapena miyezi osati zaka) munthuyo adzayamba kunena kuti akumva kuona. Adzanena zinthu monga "Ndikuona kuti Julie wangobwera tsopano, ndipo ali ndi tsitsi lake lotsitsa lero." Maso awo sakugwira ntchito, koma ubongo umakonza cholowa cha digito, kuzipereka ku gawo la kuona ndipo kuwapatsa kumva kwa kuona. Tsopano, mukagwira ntchito pang'ono zambiri, ndidzakuuzani china chake chokhudza kukhazikika kumene kudzamveka kosakhulupirira.

Ndimakhalabe ndikuvutika kukhulupirira iyi ndekha. Anthu angathe kutenga zambiri kuchokera ku zipangizo zovuta zoyezera kukhazikika (ganizani za miyeso ya mlingo wovuta), kuzisintha kukhala za digito, kutumiza feed ku chibandiko cha cholowa kwa munthu amene wataya pafupifupi ma stereocilia onse mu khutu lamkati amene amawachititsa kutha kukhazikika—munthu amene sangathe kuimirira popanda thandizo—ndipo kumuchititsa kuthekera kukhazikika pomwe. Ndipo, pakapita nthawi, kugwira ntchito kumakhala kwamphamvu—munthuyo angathe kukhala wotheka kukhazikika ngakhale popanda cholowa cha digito, chimene chimatanthauza kuti ubongo umadziphunzitsa wokha, mwanjira ina, kumanga njira ina yothekera kukhazikika. Izi ndi zenizeni. Zinachitika. Tsopano phunzirani mawu ena, ndipo chonde kumbukirani kupanga zolakwika zambiri, ndipo ndidzakuuzani china chake chokhudza maimba.

Kodi muli okonzeka kudabwanso? Tikhoza kuphunzitsa ubongo kupereka anthu amene ataya kumva kwawo luso la "kumva" kudzera mu maimba. Tikhoza ngakhale kupanga nzeru zatsopano, mwa kusandutsa kukhala za digito (mwachitsanzo) kusanthula kwa mmene anthu akumvera pa hashtag ya milungu yapakamwa kuti munthu adziwe pomwepo ngati akupanga yankho labwino kapena loipa. Palibe kusintha kwa izi kumene kumafuna maphunziro, palibe amene amafuna kuti munthu amvetse chimene chikuchitika. Zimangochitika mwachibadwa pamene ubongo upatsidwa cholowa choyenera, monga momwe tikuperekera ubongo wanu cholowa choyenera kuphunzira pa nthawi ino. Izi zidzagwira ntchito kwa inu—ubongo wanu umadziwiratu momwe ungasinthire, ndipo tikudziwa momwe tingayambitsire kusinthako kudzera mu lamulo lofunika la 10%, limene ndidzakufotokozerani pambuyo pake, ndikukulonjezani!

Kiyi imene imatilola kukusandutsa kukhala wolankhula mokhulupirira ndi kupeza ziyambitso zimene zimayambitsa mayankho ena. Mukamva buku la mawu, ndipo mukuwonjezera pang'ono liwiro la kusewera, sizidzatenga nthawi yaitali kuti liwiro latsopanolo limveke lachibadwa kwa inu. Wonjezani liwirolo pomwe, ubongo wanu udzasintha pomwe. Mukhoza kumalizira kumva mabuku a mawu pa 5 kapena 6 liwiro la nthawi yachibadwa, ndi kumvetsetsa mosavuta. Ichi ndi chifukwa chake oyendetsa a Formula 1 angathe kupita pa liwiro limene inu kapena ine sitingathe—tingangowonongeka, koma mabongo awo asinthapo ndi nthawi ku liwiro lachangu kwambiri la cholowa chakuona. Pampumulo wathu wotsatira, ndidzakuuzani china chake chodabwitsa pa momwe ubongo ungathe kusinthira mofulumira.

Kusintha mu ubongo wanu kungathe kukhala kwachangu kodabwitsa nthawi zina. Mukhozanso kuyesa izi nokha—ndidzakuuzani momwe pa mpumulo wanu wotsatira. Koma panopa: ngati munthu apatsidwa magalasi amene amasintha kuwala (ndi magalasi okhazikitsidwa mwachindunji), adzaona chilichonse ngati chotembenuzidwa. Koma patapita nthawi, adzaona chilichonse mwachibadwa pomwe—mabongo awo adzasintha cholowa chakuona kuti chimvekenso. Akachotsa magalasiwo, adzaona chilichonse chotembenuzidwa ndi maso awo (musadandaule, sizidzatenga nthawi yaitali kuti aone mwachibadwa pomwe!). Ubongo umayesa nthawi zonse kupeza tanthauzo la cholowa, ndipo mukamapanga zolakwika zambiri, mumapeza cholowa chambiri, choncho musasiye kupanga zolakwika panopa!

Nayi gawo limene mukhoza kuyesa nokha. Mukazungulirazungulira kwa nthawi yaitali, ndipo n'kuima, mudzamva chizungulire pang'ono. Chifukwa chiyani? Chikuchitika ndi chiyani? Chabwino, zina mwa izi ndi za khutu lanu lamkati, ndipo izi zimamvetsetsedwa bwino. Komanso, pamene mukuzungulira, ubongo wanu ukuyesa kutenga mtundu watsopanowu wa cholowa chakuona, ndi kuchisandutsa kukhala kumva kwachibadwa kwa chipinda chokhazikika. Mukanatha kuzungulira mokwanira, ubongo wanu ukanatha kumvetsa, ndipo mukanatha kumva ngati mukuyang'ana chipinda chokhazikika—izi ndi zomwe othamanga a ballet amayamba kumva ataphunzira mokwanira. Mukasiya kuzungulira, kuchuluka kwa chizungulire chanu ndi kuchuluka komwe ubongo wanu ukanasintha. Tsopano chipinda chokhazikika chikuoneka ngati chikuzungulira—chifukwa ubongo wanu unali kuyesa kukhazikika ku dziko latsopano momwe mukanakhala mukuzungulira nthawi zonse. Pampumulo wathu wotsatira, ndidzakuuzani zimene izi zimatanthauza kwa inu.

Choncho izi zonse zimatanthauza chiyani kwa inu? Zimatanthauza kuti ngati mukufuna ubongo wanu uchite chinachake, ndipo mupeza cholowa choyenera kwa ubongo wanu, UDZATHA kuchita. Udzatha. Izi ndi momwe ubongo umangogwirira ntchito. Ndipo mwamwayi, pambuyo pa zaka 12 za kafukufuku, tapeza cholowa choyenera kuti ubongo wanu ulankhule chilankhulo chatsopano. Mukuyenerabe kuyika khama—tsopano mukudziwa kuti masewera a mawuwa si osavuta! Mukuyenera kudzikankhani—koma mukachita, khama limene mukuyika LIDZAKUSANDUTSA kukhala wolankhula mokhulupirira. Zonse ndi zokhudzana ndi kufika ku gawo la 10%—lomwe ndikulonjeza kuti ndidzafotokoza kwambiri pambuyo pake.

Tsopano, izi zonse zodabwitsa si zenizeni kwa inu okha. Mabongo ONSE amayankha ku cholowa. Mabongo ONSE angathe kuphunzitsidwa kuchita zinthu zodabwitsa. Ubongo wanu ukanatha mosavuta kuphunzitsidwa kukumbukira mndandanda wa zinthu 100, ndi kuzinena kumapeto kapena kubwerera—ubongo wanu ukanatha kuphunzitsidwa kupititsa patsogolo kukhazikika kwanu, kapena kutukula nzeru zatsopano pogwiritsa ntchito zolowa za digito, kapena kukonza zambiri za mawu kapena kuona mofulumira—ndipo ubongo wanu ukanakhala utapatsidwa cholowa chomwe unafunikira kusukulu, mukanachoka kusukulu mukudziwa kuti muli ndi luso losavuta, lachibadwa la kuphunzira luso lililonse limene mukufuna—kuphatikiza zilankhulo zina zatsopano zilizonse ngati mumva mukufuna. Pampumulo wathu wotsatira, ndidzakuuzani momwe izi zingasinthire moyo wanu.

Si kosavuta kuvomereza momwe ubongo wanu ulili wamphamvu. Mwina simunauzidziwepo izi. Koma mukamavomereza lingaliro kuti ubongo wanu ndi wotheka kuposa chilichonse chimene munakhulupirira, mukhoza kuyamba kusankha moyo wosiyana kotheratu, wochititsa chidwi kwambiri ndi wopambana kwambiri. Moyo momwe simungolakalaka kulankhula chilankhulo chatsopano kapena kuyimba piano kapena kupeza digiri kapena kukhala mu mkhalidwe wabwino wakuthupi kapena wamaganizo—moyo momwe mukudziwa kuti mungathe kukwaniritsa zonsezi, ndipo mukudziwa kuti kupanga zolakwika kudzakuthandizani, m'malo mokukhalitsani. Tsopano, nthawi yochita ntchito pang'ono zambiri, ndipo ndidzakuuzani za opareshoni ya ubongo yosakhulupirira pafupifupi.

Kodi munamvapo za hemispherectomy? Ndi opareshoni yosachitika kawirikawiri, mayi wanga. Nthawi zambiri imachitidwa kwa ana, ndipo nthawi zambiri ndikoyesera kuthandiza matenda aakulu a khunyu, kapena kuwonongeka kwina kwakukulu kwa ubongo. Imaphatikiza kuchotsa kotheratu hafu imodzi ya ubongo. Tsopano, ngati simuli abwino pa sayansi, kapena simuli ndi kukumbukira kogwira ntchito kwamphamvu, kumatanthauza kuti ubongo wanu si wabwino ngati anthu "anzeru", choncho kuchotsa hafu ya ubongo kunganene kuti anthu amenewo sangathe kugwira ntchito, si choncho? Ayenera kukhala osatha kukhala moyo wodziyimira pawokha, si choncho? Phunzirani pang'ono zambiri, ndipo ndidzakuuzani yankho posachedwa.

Mu kafukufuku wofalitsidwa mu 2019, Dorit Kliemann (purofesa wothandiza pa Yunivesite ya Iowa) anayesa umoyo wa ubongo wa anthu akuluakulu asanu ndi mmodzi amene anachitidwa hemispherectomies ali ana (wodwala wamng'ono kwambiri anali ndi miyezi 3 yokha pa nthawi ya opareshoni, wamkulu kwambiri anali ndi zaka 11). Mawu ake okhudza kafukufukuyu ndi odabwitsa kwambiri. "Anthu omwe anachitidwa hemispherectomies omwe tinawafufuza anali ogwira ntchito bwino kwambiri modabwitsa," anatero mu nkhani ya kafukufuku. "Ali ndi maluso a chilankhulo athunthu. Ndinawayika mu sikena, tinachita nkhani, monga anthu mazana amene ndayezapo. Mukhoza pafupifupi kuiwala mkhalidwe wawo pamene mukukumana nawo koyamba." Muloleni izi zikufikeni, pamene mukuphunzira pang'ono zambiri, ndipo ndidzakuuzani zimene zimatanthauza kwa inu mu mphindi zochepa.

Choncho, anthu omwe ali ndi hafu ya ubongo okha amaoneka pafupifupi ofanana—kwa ofufuza akatswiri—ndi anthu omwe ali ndi ubongo wathunthu. Ngakhale pamene hafu yake yachotsedwa, ubongo ungathe kupeza njira yogwirira ntchito bwino mokwanira kulola mwini wake kukhala moyo wachibadwa modabwitsa. Ngati munthu wina amene ali ndi hafu ya ubongo angathe kuchita zambiri, nanga bwanji inu, ndi ubongo wanu wathunthu? A, kukumbukira kwanu kogwira ntchito sikuli kwabwino? Simuli abwino pa sayansi? Simunali wachibadwa pa zilankhulo? Chonde. Muli ndi mawiri ubongo wa munthu amene anachitidwa hemispherectomy akukhala moyo wachibadwa kwambiri. Muli wothekera kotheratu kukhala wolankhula mokhulupirira ndi wodabwitsa. Yesani kumayika khama—monga, panopa. Tikukanikizani mu gawo lofunika la 10% pa nthawiyi—pitirizani kuchita, ndipo posachedwa ndidzakuuzani chifukwa.

Tsopano, ndakupemphani kuchita zolakwika, ndipo ngati muli ngati anthu ambiri, simukonda kuchita zolakwika. Mwina munauziridwa kusukulu kuti zolakwika ndi zoipa. Koma pamene mukuphunzira chilankhulo chatsopano, zolakwika ndi zabwino. Pali mitundu iwiri yokha ya zolakwika—yoyamba ndi zimene simukuzizindikira, zimene si vuto chifukwa simukuzindikira. Yachiwiri ndi imene mukuzindikira kuti chimene munanena chinali chosiyana ndi chitsanzo chimene munamva. Kuti muzindikire izi, ubongo wanu uyenera kuyerekezera chimene munanena ndi chitsanzo, ndi kuzindikira kusiyana. Ndipo tili ndi dzina lina la ndondomeko imeneyi—pamene ubongo wanu umapeza cholowa chimene umafunikira kusintha—timatchula kuphunzira. Nthawi zonse mukuzindikira kuti mukuchita cholakwika, mukuzindikira kwenikweni kuti ubongo wanu ukuphunzira zambiri. Choncho chonde, pitirizani kupanga zolakwika zomwezo—mukamapanga zambiri, mukamaphunzira mofulumira. Pampumulo wathu wotsatira, ndidzakuthandizani kuyamba kumva bwino za kukhumudwa.

Kodi mumakhumudwa pamene simungathe kukumbukira mawu amene mukuyesa kuphunzira? Ndi kumva kwachibadwa kwambiri... Mukuyesa kukumbukira, mukudziwa kuti sikusiya kutali (mukhozanso kunena "Zili pamunomo panga!")—ndipo kenako wina akunena, ndipo mukumva kuti mukufuna kudzimenya—munali PAFUPI kwambiri! Tsopano, nkhani ndi iyi... anthu ena amatopa kwambiri kumva kukhumudwako, amamalizira kutaya mphamvu—ndipo ulendo wawo wopita ku chilankhulo chawo chatsopano umayimitsidwa (kapena ngakhale, nthawi zina, umangosiya). Kukhumudwa kungathe kukuimitsirani kukhala wolankhula mokhulupirira—koma mukandiphunzira pang'ono panopa, ndidzakuuzani momwe mungathetsere vuto la kukhumudwa.

Kukhumudwa kumachokera ku kumvetsetsa kolakwika. Nthawi zambiri kumayamba kusukulu. Mumauziridwa kuti mwaphunzira chinachake, kapena simunaphunzire. Ngati simunaphunzire, mukuyenera kubwereza mobwerezabwereza mpaka "muphunzira". Tsopano, nayi vuto la izi... Zokumbukira sizimapangidwa kamodzi—kupatula zokumbukira za zochitika zomveka kwambiri, zimene nthawi zambiri siziphatikizana ndi mawu. Ndidzakuuzani chimene ndikutanthauza, ndi chifukwa chake ndi chofunika kwa inu, pang'ono kenako.

Choncho, zokumbukira. Nthawi zonse mukumana ndi mawu atsopano, mumalemba zambiri zambirizo. Mukhoza kuyamba pozindikira kuti ali ndi zigawo zingati. Kenako mukhoza kukumbukira mavawelo ena—kenako makonsonanti ena. Pamapeto pake, mutakumana nawo mokwanira, mungathe kuwazindikira mukamva—ndipo nthawi yina pambuyo pake, mungathe kuwanena mukafuna. Mwatsoka... Ndi pamene mungathe kunena nthawi iliyonse mukufuna kuti mumve ngati <tgt>mwaphunzira</tgt>. Zinthu zonse zina—kuzindikira zigawo, kuwonjezera mavawelo, kuwonjezera makonsonanti—zonsezi zimachitika pansi pa mtunda wa maganizo anu ozindikirika. Simungathe kuona kuti mukufika pafupi ku kukumbukira kopambana kwa mawuwo—choncho, mumamva kuipa za inu nokha, kapena mumakhulupirira kuti mukufunikira kuchita maphunziro ambiri owonjezera. Koma pali chizindikiro <tgt>chimodzi</tgt> kuti muli pafupi kupambana... Ndidzakuuzani pang'ono kenako, mukaphunzira pang'ono zambiri.

Choncho, pali chizindikiro chimodzi chokha chimene chimakuuzani kuti mukufika pafupi ndi pafupi kupambana pamene mukuphunzira mawu atsopano... Kodi chizindikiro chimodzicho ndi chiti? Ndi kukhumudwa kumene mumamva pamene simungathe kukumbukira mawuwo—pamene ali "pamunomo panga!" Ndikakufunsani kunena mawu amene simunamvepo, simumva kukhumudwa kulikonse—munganene "Ayi, pepani, sindidziwa." Ndikakufunsani kunena mawu amene mwapatsira pafupi kuphunzira, simungathe kuwapeza, ndipo mumamva kukhumudwako—kupweteka!—kumene kumawoneka ngati wina akukubayani ndi singano. Chifukwa chiyani kupwetekako ndi kwabwino? Ndidzakuuzani pang'ono kenako.

Choncho... pamene mumamva kupweteka... pamene mukumva kukhumudwa chifukwa chosadza chinachake chokumbukira... Kutanthauza kuti mwapatsira pafupi kupambana. Ndi chizindikiro <tgt>chimodzi</tgt> kuti muli pafupi. Chimene chimatanthauza... Nthawi yotsatira mukamva kupweteka—nthawi yotsatira mukafuna kudzimenya—imani kanthawi. Werengani chizindikiro. Dziwitsani kuti chimatanthauza kuti muli <tgt>pafupi</tgt>. Ndipo kenako kukhumudwa kwanu kuyenera kusanduka kunyadira. Muyenera kunyadira kuti muli pafupi kwambiri kupanga chokumbukira chopambana kwa nthawi yaitali. Nthawi zonse mukumva kukhumudwa, kumatanthauza kuti mwapatsira pafupi kupambana—choncho sanduzani kukhumudwa kwanu kukhala kunyadira. Mukugwira ntchito molimbika, mukupereka ubongo wanu cholowa chimene chimafunikira, mukukankhira malire anu, ndipo mukusanduka wolankhula mokhulupirira—muyenera kunyadira. Pampumulo wathu wotsatira, ndidzakuuzani chifukwa chake simufunikira kudandaula za ziganizo zimene zimangooneka zitali kwambiri.

Kodi mumadandaula pang'ono za kusapeza ziganizo zitali? Ndi kofunika kwambiri kuti muvomereze kuti ziganizo zitali zili pomwepo kutambasula ubongo wanu, kumuvuta—simufunikira kuzipeza bwino, mukungofunikira kuchita mwakhama ndipo mulole kukumana kowonjezera kukankhira ubongo wanu ku 'chunking'—chimene chimatanthauza kukhazikitsa mawu angapo pamodzi ndi kuwakonza ngati ali chinthu chimodzi. Mukamamva ndi kuyesa kunena ziganizo zitali zambiri, ngakhale mupeze mawu ochepa okha poyamba, ubongo wanu udzayamba 'chunking' mofulumira. Ndikopweteka, ndikudziwa, koma ndi kupweteka kofunika kwambiri, ndipo kumakuchititsani kugwiritsa ntchito chilankhulo chanu chatsopano mwachibadwa ndi mofulumira kuposa kugwira ntchito ndi ziganizo zifupi. Choncho musadandaule za zitali! Chitani mwakhama nazo, ndipo ndi bwino. Pampumulo wathu wotsatira, ndidzakuuzani chifukwa chake simufunikira kubwereza.

Pamene simungathe kukumbukira mawu, nthawi zambiri mukufuna 'kubwerera ndi kubwereza'—ndizo zimene sukulu inakuuzani kuti muyenera kuchita—koma ndi njira yolakwika, ndipo simungathe 'kubwerera' ndi Njira ya 'Say Something In'. Kwenikweni, tinalola anthu 'kubwerera', koma zinangotanthauza kuti anakhalitsa mu misampha yangwiro, pomwe akasiya kuyenda ndi kuphunzira chifukwa sanafune kupanga zolakwika. Tsopano, tayika izi kuti muyenera kupitiriza kuyenda—koma musadandaule, mawu aliwonse adzabwerezedwa pamene mukupitiriza kuyenda—mu ndondomeko yotchedwa kubwereza kosiyanitsa, yomwe kwenikweni imatsogolera kuphunzira mofulumira kwambiri. Choncho ngati simungathe kukumbukira mawu, musadandaule—khulupirirani ubongo wanu ndi ndondomeko—simunatsirize kuphunzira, koma tidzapitiriza kubweretsa mawuwo kubwereza mpaka muwapeze. Simukufunika kudandaula, simukufunika kudera nkhawa, simukufunika kuganiza za nthawi yobwerezera zinthu—timachita zonsezi kwa inu. Khulupirirani ndondomeko, ndipo pitirizani kuyenda. Aa, ndipo sindinaiwale kuti ndinalonjeza kuti ndidzakuuzani za lamulo lofunika kwambiri la 10%—tili pafupi.

Masiku ena mumamva kuti mukuchita zolakwika zambiri kuposa nthawi zachibadwa—kuti mawu omwe munaganiza kuti mwaphunzira sakugwira ntchito chifukwa china chake. Izi zimachitika kwa aliyense—aliyense—tonse tili ndi masiku amene timamva ndi mphamvu zambiri ndi kudzuka, monga momwe tili ndi masiku amene timamva osangalala kwambiri kapena achisoni kwambiri—ndi kuyenda kwachibadwa kwa moyo. Pamene muli ndi tsiku lovuta, khalani osunga ndi inu nokha—tengani mpumulo, dzipatseni mphatso ya mtundu wina, dziwani kuti mphamvu yanu ndi yotsika ndipo musadzifunse zambiri. Kusunga kumachititsa kukhala kosavuta kupitiriza kuyenda pamene mphamvu yanu yakhala bwino pomwe—musasandutse kuphunzira chilankhulo chanu chatsopano kukhala ntchito yomwe mumadana nayo, sinthani kukhala chinachake chimene mukusewera nacho ndi kuchichita pamene mukumva bwino ndi osangalala, ndipo chidzakhala chachangu kwambiri ndi chosangalatsa kwambiri. Bwererani ku ntchito tsopano, ndipo pampumulo wathu wotsatira, ndiyesa kusiya kulankhula za zolakwika!

Ndikudziwa kuti ndakhala ndimalankhula kwambiri za zolakwika! Ndi lingaliro lofunika kwambiri kuti mulipeze bwino—pamene mukudziwa kuti cholakwika chilichonse chikusamala kwenikweni chilankhulo chanu chatsopano, pamene mukumva bwino za zolakwika zanu, pamene mukumvetsetsa kuti ndiye chinsinsi cha kupambana kwanu, mumasanduka wolankhula mokhulupirira wosapewereka. Ichi ndi chinthu chimodzi chofunika kwambiri kuti mumvetsetse, ndi chifukwa chake ndimachilankhula kwambiri. Koma sindikufuna kukubosetsani! Sindikufuna kupitiriza kufotokoza. Choncho kuyambira tsopano, ndikungokukumbutsani, nthawi zina, kuti musangalalire zolakwika zanu. Pamene ndinena musangalalire zolakwika zanu, ndikufuna mukumbukire chifukwa—pamene ubongo wanu ukuzindikira kusiyana, ndi pamene ubongo wanu ukuphunzira, ndipo kukumana kosalekeza ndi mawu ndi machitidwe kudzapanga zokumbukira zopambana kwa inu chifukwa cha kubwereza kosiyanitsa, ndipo kukhumudwa kumatanthauza kuti ubongo wanu watsala pang'ono kumaliza kulemba mawuwo. Zolakwika ndi zabwino kwa inu. Zolakwika zimakuthandizani. Choncho sangalalani ndi zolakwika zanu! Pampumulo wathu wotsatira, pamapeto pake, ndidzakuuzani za lamulo la 10% lomwe ndi kiyi yophunzira chilankhulo chilichonse bwino.

Chabwino, pamapeto pake, nthawi ya lamulo la 10%! Izi ndi zenizeni pa chilichonse ndi chilichonse chimene mukufuna kukwaniritsa mu moyo wanu wonse—ndi momwe kuphunzira konse kumangogwirira ntchito. Nayi. Mukachita chinachake chimene munakhoza kale kuchichita, simukukhala bwino—mukungosungira mulingo wanu wopezeka. Ngati mungathe kuchita mapushups 10, ndipo muchita mapushups 10, bwino—mukukhala wotheka kuchita mapushups 10—koma simudzakhala bwino mwa kungochita mapushups 10. Ngati mungathe kuchita mapushups 10, ndipo ndikukufunsani kuchita mapushups 100, ndiye kuti mudzalephera—simungathe kukhala bwino mochangu—choncho mudzayesa, ndipo mudzalephera, ndipo mudzamva kuipa, ndipo simudzakhala bwino. Koma ndikakufunsani kuchita mapushups 11—10% owonjezera—mungathe kuchita izi, ndipo mwangokhala bwino pang'ono. Mukachita 10% owonjezera tsiku lililonse, kudzatenga masiku osachepera 30 kuchita mapushups 100. Pampumulo wathu wotsatira, ndidzakuuzani zambiri za zimene izi zimatanthauza kwa chilankhulo chanu chatsopano.

Choncho, 10% owonjezera ndi okwanira kuyambitsa kusintha—ndipo mukapitiriza 10% kunja kwa gawo lanu losangalala, kupititsa patsogolo pamapeto pake kumakhala kodabwitsa. Ndiye zimene mukuchita ndi Njira ya 'Say Something In'. Yakhazikitsidwa kuti ikusungeni pafupi kwambiri 10% kunja kwa gawo lanu losangalala nthawi zonse. Ziganizo zomwe zili zitali kwambiri, mawu omwe sitinawabwerezapo kwa kanthawi, machitidwe atsopano omwe tikuponya—chilichonse mu njirayi chakhazikitsidwa kuti chikusungeni 10% kunja kwa gawo lanu losangalala. Tagawana tekinoloji iyi ndi aphunzitsi ndi olangiza masewera ndi anthu otchuka a mawu ndi akatswiri aboma—chifukwa imagwira ntchito kulikonse kumene muigwiritsa ntchito. Chilichonse chimene mumafuna kukhala bwino, funani chomwe mungathe kuchichita chimene chili 10% kunja kwa gawo lanu losangalala, ndipo pitirizani 10% kunja kwa nthawi yokwanira, ndipo zotsatira zidzakudabwitsani. Ndipo ndi chilankhulo chanu chatsopano, chimene mungachichite ndi kukhulupirira njirayi—sindidzalola kuti ikhale yosavuta kwa inu, choncho simudzasiya kukhala bwino! Pampumulo wathu wotsatira, ndikufuna kukuchenjezani za kufuna kwangwiro.

Mukhoza kuganiza kuti mukufuna kukwaniritsa kwangwiro ndi chilankhulo chanu chatsopano. Mukhoza kuganiza kuti zonse ndi zakufuna kwangwiro. Mukhoza kudabwa pamene ndinena kuti ndikufuna kukuchenjezani za kufuna kwangwiro. Koma nayi choonadi—kufuna kwangwiro ndiye mdani waukulu kwambiri wa kuphunzira chilankhulo. Kufuna kwangwiro si momwe zilankhulo zimagwirira ntchito—timalankhula mofulumira, timasintha maganizo athu pakati pa chimene timanenatcho, timaiwala zinthu, timayambiranso—mukadzilembera mukumalankhula chilankhulo chanu choyamba ndipo kenako mupeza wina kuti azilembe, mudabwa ndi zolakwika zambiri zotchedwa zimene mumapanga. Koma zili bwino—ndi momwe chilankhulo chimangogwirira ntchito. Ndipo pali choonadi chimodzi chofunika kwambiri ndi kuphunzira chilankhulo—ndi chofunika pafupifupi monga lamulo la 10%—mukamalankhula kwambiri, mumaphunzira mofulumira. Ndipo mukamadandaula za kupanga zolakwika—pamene mukufuna kukhala wangwiro—mumalankhula pang'ono, ndipo mumaphunzira mochedwa. Ndidzakuuzani njira zina zimene kufuna kwangwiro kumawonongereza kuphunzira kwanu pampumulo wathu wotsatira.

Anthu omwe amafuna kukhala angwiro amakhala othekera kwambiri kunena chilichonse pa mpata, chifukwa sakufuna kuyamba kulankhula mpaka akhala otsimikiza kuti akhoza kupeza chilichonse bwino. Izi zimachedwetsa kuphunzira kwanu—ndi kwabwino kudumpha ndi kunena chilichonse chimene mungathe, mofulumira momwe mungathere, ndipo kenako mumve mosamalitsa zitsanzo. Anthu okonda kwangwiro amadana ndi lamulo la 10%—amafuna kuti chilichonse chikhale cholamulika, kuti akhoze kupeza chilichonse bwino—ndipo sayansi imawonetsa kuti izi zimatsogolera kuphunzira mochedwa. Lamulo la 10% ndi lofunika kwambiri pa kuphunzira konse—muyenera kukhala kutali mokwanira kuchokera ku gawo lanu losangalala kuti mukhale osakondwa ndi kupanga zolakwika—pamenepo ndi pomwe kuphunzira kwachangu ndi kwabwino kwambiri kumachitikira. Ngati simudzapitako chifukwa mukufuna kukhala wangwiro, kuphunzira kwanu kudzawonongeka, ndipo mudzakhala wosathekera kukhala wolankhula mokhulupirira. Pampumulo wathu wotsatira, ndidzakupatsani njira ina yoganizira kufuna kwangwiro imene ingakuthandizeni kusiya, ngati mumavutika ndi kufuna kwangwiro (ndipo aliyense amavutika, osachepera pang'ono!).

Choncho, kufuna kwangwiro kumapweteka kuphunzira chilankhulo chifukwa mukufuna kunena chiganizo chilichonse mwangwiro, choncho mumapita mochedwa ndi kuphunzira pang'ono. Koma nanga bwanji mukanaganiza mwanjira ina? M'malo moyesa kupeza chiganizo chilichonse mwangwiro, nanga bwanji mukanapanga chisankho kuti mupeze kwangwiro MOMWE mukuphunzirira? Ngati munapanga chisankho kuphunzira mwanjira yachangu kwambiri, yabwino kwambiri, yangwiro kwambiri? Chifukwa kwangwiro pa kuphunzira chilankhulo kumatanthauza kupita mofulumira kwambiri momwe mungathere ndi kupanga zolakwika zambiri momwe mungathere ndi kupereka ubongo wanu kukumana kwambiri momwe kungathere ndi chilankhulo chatsopano. Mukachita zonsezi, mukukhala pafupi kwangwiro ngati wophunzira chilankhulo. Mukadziuza kuti nthawi iliyonse mukachita cholakwika, mukufika pafupi kukhala wophunzira chilankhulo wangwiro, mwina izi zingakuthandizeni kusiya kufunikira kukhala wolamulira—ndipo mukasiya kufunikirako kulamulira, kupambana kwanu ndikosapewereka. Chabwino, bwererani ku ntchito tsopano, ndipo nthawi yotsatira ndikufuna kukuuzani chinachake chofunika chokhudza kulankhula.

Kodi mukulankhula pa mpata, si choncho? Ndinena, mokweza? Ngakhale ngati nthawi zina kumamva manyazi? Tamva za ophunzira amalankhula pa basi, pa sitima, pamene akuyendetsa galu—kumamva kochilendo poyamba, koma mumazolowezereka msanga. Chifukwa chiyani mungamve manyazi kuti mukuphunzira luso latsopano lodabwitsa? Ndipo kulankhula ndi kofunika kwambiri—chifukwa kumawonjezera ma circuit a mitsempha owonjezera ku zokumbukira zimene mukumanga, ndipo tikamawonjezerako ma circuit a mitsempha ambiri ku chokumbukira, chimakhala champhamvu. Mukamalankhula mokweza pa mpata uliwonse—simufunikira kukhala wangwiro, yengonena mawu aliwonse amene mukukumbukira—ndiye kuti mukumanga zokumbukira zamphamvu, ndipo mukuzimanga mofulumira, ndipo mudzakhala opambana kwambiri. Choncho lankhulani mokweza pa mpata uliwonse, ngakhale kudabwitsa munthu wokhala pafupi nanu pa basi! Ndipo pamene mukulankhula mokweza, ndidzakonzekera kukuuzani chokhudza Dulani ndi Bwerezani pampumulo wathu wotsatira...

Malangizo otsatira adzakuonetsani momwe mungapangire luso latsopano limene lidzafulumizire osati kuphunzira kwanu kwa chilankhulo kokha komanso kukuthandizani kupeza zambiri ndithu m'gawo lililonse la moyo wanu. Ndanena zambiri za chifukwa chake musadandaule za zolakwika, ndipo tsopano ndidzafotokoza zenizeni MOMWE mungadziletse—mwa kulowa mu zimene anthu a masewera amatchula kuti Malo Okonzeka. Malo Okonzeka ndi malo amatsenga aja pamene masewera amene mukusewera amaoneka mosadziwika kuti ndi osavuta ndi oonekera—osewera tenesi ndi cricket amanena za 'kuona mpira waukulu'. Mukasakha pa intaneti njira zolowera mu Malo Okonzeka, mudzapeza zambiri zovuta nthawi zina—koma ndithu, pali chinthu chimodzi chokha chokha chimene mukufunika kuchita, ndipo chidzagwira ntchito mosalekeza ndi mokhulupirira ngati ntchito imene munaliyamba kuchita kumanga ma synapses a chilankhulo chanu chatsopano. Tsopano ngati muikira maganizo momwe mungathere kuphunzira pang'ono, ndidzakuuzani momwe mulowere mu Malo Okonzeka pa mpumulo wathu wotsatira.

Chabwino—nthawi yakwana yophunzira momwe mulowere mu Malo Okonzeka—ndipo mutaphunzira izi, mudzatha kulowa mu Malo Okonzeka ndi chilichonse chimene mukuchita, ndipo zotsatira zidzakudabwitsani. Pali chinthu chimodzi chokha chimene mukufunika kuchita—Malo Okonzeka ndithu ndi mawu ena a kuika maganizo—ndipo mungathe kuphunzitsa ndi kubwezera luso lanu la kuika maganizo. Mwina mukuganiza kuti maganizo anu ndi malo amodzi pamene maganizo ndi malingaliro anu amangoyendayenda, koma pali kugawana kofunika kwambiri pakati pa gawo la maganizo anu pamene maganizo ndi malingaliro amachitika, ndi gawo losiyana, lamphamvu kwambiri ndi lophunzitsika. Tiyeni tilitchule kuti Maganizo Ozindikira. Pamene muli mu maganizo ozindikira—ataikiratu maganizo—mulibe malo a maganizo kapena malingaliro. Zili ngati batani yozimitsa kuganiza ndi kumva, ndipo pa mpumulo wathu wotsatira ndidzakuuzani chifukwa chake izi ndi zofunika kwambiri.

Choncho, maganizo ozindikira ndi batani yozimitsa maganizo ndi malingaliro. Zimatanthauza kuti mukamadziwika kuti muli ndi ganizo kapena malingaliro—mukamva kukwiya kapena kumva chisoni chifukwa munanena chinachake chimene sichinayendane ndi zitsanzo—mwatuluka mu Maganizo Ozindikira. Mukakhala mu maganizo ozindikira, mukaikira maganizo kotheratu pa mawu amene mukumva, palibe malo a maganizo kapena malingaliro. Ndipo, ngati zamatsenga, mukaikira maganizo kotheratu pa mawu, mukupatsa ubongo wanu kuona kwabwino kwambiri chilankhulo, chimene chidzathandiza kuphunzira chilankhulo chanu chatsopano mwachangu koposa. Mwa mawu ena, mukakhala ndi malingaliro oipa, ndi chizindikiro kwa inu kuti simuikira maganizo kotheratu pa kuphunzira. Musayimve inu oipa—ndi zachibadwa—koma pali chinthu chimodzi chosavuta chimene mungathe kuchita chimene chidzabwezera kwambiri luso lanu la kukhala mu maganizo ozindikira, ndipo ndidzakuuzani za izo mwa mphindi zochepa, mutaphunzira pang'ono.

Choncho, maganizo anu ozindikira ndi njira imodzi yabwino kwambiri yobwezera kuphunzira kwanu, ndipo mukakhala ndi mayankho a malingaliro oipa, zimatanthauza kuti mwatuluka mu maganizo anu ozindikira—mwataya kuika maganizo. Timakonza bwanji zimenezo? Ndi zosavuta kwambiri. Nthawi iliyonse mukakhala ndi mayankho a malingaliro oipa, chimene mukufunika kuchita ndi kuchizindikira—dziwuzeni 'oh, ndili ndi mayankho a malingaliro oipa, ndipo tsopano ndidzabwezeretsa maganizo anga ku ndondomeko ya kuphunzira'. Izi zili ngati kuchita ma push-ups a maganizo ozindikira—nthawi iliyonse mukazindikira kuti muli ndi mayankho a malingaliro, ndipo mubwezere maganizo anu ku ndondomeko ya kuphunzira, mukukhala abwino pa kukhala mu maganizo ozindikira. Yambani kuchita izi mpumulo uwu ukangosile, ndipo nthawi yomweyo mudzayamba kudzisandutsa wophunzira wabwino—ndipo ndikadzaganiza kuti mwakhala ndi nthawi yokwanira kumanga khasu lowonjezera la maganizo anu ozindikira, ndidzakuuzani za mphamvu zina zimene zimatsegula kwa inu. Tsopano, pa mpumulo wathu wotsatira, ndidzakuuzani za chimene ndimatchula 'mawu anu amkati', chimene chili gawo lina lofunika kwambiri la ulendo wanu wa kuphunzira.

Mawu anu amkati ndi njira ya ubongo wanu yokuthandizani kupulumuka, koma pali vuto limodzi lalikulu ndi izi. Ubongo wanu wakonzedwa bwino kwambiri kupulumuka mu chilengedwe choopsa chodzaza ndi nyama zolusa, chimene chimatanthauza kuti chimayang'ana zoopsa, zowopsya, zinthu zoipa kuposa zinthu zabwino. Koma simukuyesa kuphunzira chilankhulo chanu chatsopano mu chilengedwe choopsa chodzaza ndi nyama zolusa—osachepera, ndikukhulupirira kuti simuli! Choncho ubongo wanu ukamayang'ana ku zoipa—ndachita cholakwika, sindikukumbukira mawuwo, chiganizo chinali chitali kwambiri, sindikuchita bwino mokwanira—zimachedwetsa kwenikweni ndondomeko ya kuphunzira. Kudera nkhawa ndi kudandaula ndi kudzisola kumachepetsa kwenikweni luso la ubongo la kuphunzira. Mukufunikira kuphunzitsanso mawu anu amkati kukhala wothandiza wanu waukulu, ndipo ndidzakupatsani maganizo ena pa momwe mungachitire izi pampumulo wathu wotsatira. Panopa, bwererani ku kuphunzira, ndipo chenjerani ndi nyama zoopsa zija...

Mukangouza mawu anu amkati kuti asakhale oipa, sizigwira ntchito. Ubongo sugwira ntchito choncho. Umafunikira zapadera, ndipo umafunikira kukhazikika. Choncho mukufunikira kuganiza za zinthu zingapo zabwino za inu nokha—kuzilemba kungathe kukhala lingaliro labwino, pomwe mumachita kawirikawiri kuphunzira kwanu. Mwachitsanzo, mukuyika khama lalikulu kuphunzira chilankhulo chatsopano—ndikoyenera kuyamikiridwa, muyenera kunyadira. Mukudzikankhira mu gawo la 10%, ndipo ndi kulimba mtima. Mukupereka ubongo wanu kukumana kwambiri ndi chilankhulo chatsopano, ndipo zimathandiza kupambana. Mukumanga ma synapses atsopano, zimene zimafunikira khama lenileni ndipo zimachotsa mphamvu kwambiri, choncho muyenera kuyamikiridwa nthawi iliyonse mukachita. Ndipo kenako, mukakhala ndi mndandanda wanu wa zinthu zabwino za inu nokha, nthawi iliyonse mukuzindikira kuti mawu anu amkati akukuuzani china chake choipa, yankhani ndi chimodzi cha zinthu zabwino. Nthawi iliyonse. Mu masabata ochepa okha, mudzamva kusiyana kwakukulu, ndipo kudzakhudza moyo wanu wonse, osati ulendo wanu wa kuphunzira chilankhulo wokha. Pampumulo wathu wotsatira, ndidzakuuzani pang'ono zambiri za kutopa.

Kukhala mu gawo la 10% kumatopetsa—ndicho chimodzi mwa zizindikiro kuti mukuphunzira bwino, kwenikweni. Koma kutopa ndi koonadi—ndi koona ngati kutopa kumene mumamva mukathamanga nthawi yaitali. Ubongo wanu ndi wochita mphamvu—ndi 2% chabe cha kulemera kwa thupi lanu, koma umagwiritsa ntchito 20% ya mphamvu yanu yonse. Choncho mukamachititsa kuti ugwire ntchito mwamphamvu momwe ungathere, mukugwiritsa ntchito mphamvu zambiri, ndipo mudzatopa—mwina mwazindikira kale! Ndipo mukatopa, mumapanga zolakwika zambiri, ndipo mumamva ngati simukuchita bwino. Koma nayi chinthu chochititsa chidwi—ngakhale mukatopa, ndipo mukupanga zolakwika zambiri, ubongo wanu ukuphunzirabe bwino kwambiri. Choncho dzikhululukireni pa zolakwika zanu, zindikirani kuti mwatopa, khalani osunga ndi inu nokha, koma pitirizani—muli pa njira ya chipambano. Ndipo pali chinthu china chochititsa chidwi kwambiri za kutopa, koma chingadikire mpaka pampumulo wathu wotsatira.

Nthawi zambiri zimakutengani nthawi yaitali bwanji mpaka muyambe kumva kutopa, pamene mukuphunzira chilankhulo chatsopano ndi app ya 'Say Something In'? Kwa anthu ena ndi mphindi zisanu kapena khumi, ena angathe kupita mpaka hafu ya ola kapena kupitirirapo, koma aliyense amatopa pa nthawi ina. Kodi mukukumbukira chimene ndinanena za kufulumitsa kuphunzira kwanu? Kuti ngati muyesa kugwiritsa ntchito Dulani kuphunzira mofulumira nthawi iliyonse kumamveka kosavuta kwambiri, mukhoza kuyambitsa kusintha mu ubongo wanu kumene kungathe kukulolani kuphunzira mofulumira? Chabwino, chimodzimodzi chimakhala choona ndi kutopa. Mukasiya ndendende mukamva kutopa, zili bwino—pitilizani kuchita pang'ono tsiku lililonse, kapena sabata iliyonse, ndipo mudzapitiriza kukhala bwino, ndipo pamapeto pake mudzatha kulankhula mokhulupirira. Koma mukapitiriza—mphindi zisanu zowonjezera chabe—pamene mukuyamba kumva kutopa, pang'onopang'ono mudzapeza kuti mungathe kuphunzira kwa nthawi yaitali musanatope. Mukatha kuchita hafu ya ola mu seshoni iliyonse, mukachita seshoni tsiku lililonse mudzaphunzira mofulumira modabwitsa. Mukatha kuchita ola limodzi, kapena maola awiri, mungathe kuchita seshoni imodzi chabe sabata iliyonse ndipo mudzapitiriza kuphunzira mofulumira modabwitsa. Koma mukhoza, ngati mukufuna, kupita ngakhale kupitirira—ndidzafotokoza pampumulo wathu wotsatira.

Ola limodzi kapena awiri mwina amaoneka ngati changamoto yovuta kwenikweni—chifukwa ndi yovuta—izi mwina ndi ntchito yovuta kwambiri imene mungachititse ubongo wanu kuchita. Koma nayi nkhaniyi—ubongo wanu ndi wabwino kwambiri pa kugwiritsa ntchito chilankhulo, kulankhula. Mu miyoyo yathu yachibadwa, timakhala timalankhula pafupifupi tsiku lonse, ndipo nthawi zambiri sitizindikira ngakhale khama. Mukapitiriza kuchita mphindi zochepa zowonjezera mukatopa, pamapeto pake mudzapeza kuti ubongo wanu ungathe kuphunzira tsiku lonse—tikudziwa anthu amene amachita maola asanu ndi atatu kapena khumi kapena ngakhale khumi ndi awiri pogwiritsa ntchito App ya 'Say Something In' pa tsiku. Ndipo mungathe kupitiriza kuchita izi kupitirira tsiku limodzi—anthu ena achita masiku khumi otsatana, ndipo chimene amaphunzira pa nthawi imeneyo ndi kupitirira chimene sukulu kapena yunivesite iliyonse ingakhulupirire. Choncho ngati mumakonda kudzivuta, onani ngati mungathe kuchita maola awiri osayima. Ndipo mukatha, onani chimene chingachitike mukayesa anayi. Mukasintha kuchita tsiku lathunthu lopanda kuima, liwiro lanu la kuphunzira lidzasinthidwa kotheratu. Koma panopa, tiyeni tipitirize ndi chimene munali mukuchita kale.

Tsopano, ngati munamva kutopa pokha pondimva ndikuti mupange ola limodzi kapena awiri kapena kupitirirapo, nawa nkhani yolimbikitsa kwa inu—sizikukhudza ngati simudzachita! Nthawi iliyonse imene inu muli omasuka nayo, mukapitiriza kosalekeza mudzapeza zotsatira—choncho ngati lingaliro la kuchita maola awiri kapena tsiku lathunthu limakuchititsani mantha, musadzidetse nkhawa ndi izo, ndipo musazichite. Mukuchita bwino kwambiri kale kuti mwafika kutali, ndipo mukapitiriza pa liwiro limene mwamuchita mpaka pano, ubongo wanu udzapitiriza kusintha, ndipo mudzakhala wolankhula mokhulupirira. Choncho bwino kwambiri—chifukwa chomufika kutali, chifukwa chokhala ndi njira imene ikukugwirirani ntchito kale, ndi chifukwa choyesa kudzikankhira pang'ono kwambiri nthawi zina NGATI NDI NGATI KOKHA mumva kuti mukufuna. Tsopano, bwererani ku ntchito.

Mukamayamba kupita mozama mu chilankhulo chatsopano chilichonse, mumayamba kupeza kuti pali njira zosiyanasiyana zonena chimodzimodzi, kapena kunena lingaliro lomwelo. Ngati simunayamba, mwina mudzayamba kupeza izi mu maola awiri kapena atatu otsatira a kuphunzira. Mukuphunzira ndi App ya 'Say Something In', izi zikhoza kumveka zokhumudwitsa—mumanena njira imodzi, mumamva njira ina, ndipo mumamva ngati mwachita cholakwika. Tsopano, ndithu, tsopano mukudziwa kuti zolakwika ndi zinthu zabwino—koma mtundu uwu wa cholakwika si cholakwika kwenikweni. Kwenikweni, ndi monga kupeza ziwiri pa mtengo wa chimodzi—mulimbikitsa pang'ono ma synapses anu pa njira imene mumanena, ndipo kenako mumamva njira ina ndi kulimbikitsa pang'ono ma synapses anu pa chosankhacho pomwe. Choncho nthawi iliyonse mukayamba kuzindikira kuti muli ndi njira zopitirira imodzi zonena chinachake, muyenera kunyadira kuti mwafika kutali, ndipo nthawi iliyonse mukamva chosankha chosiyana ndi chimene munanena, muyenera kusangalala kuti mwapeza ziwiri pa mtengo wa chimodzi. Chabwino, tiyeni tipitirize.

Tsopano mwachita ntchito yambiri, ndipo mungathe kunena zinthu zambiri zosiyanasiyana mu chilankhulo chanu chatsopano, pali chizolowezi chaching'ono chimene mungapange chimene chingapange kusiyana kofunika kwenikweni pa momwe mukupitira patsogolo mofulumira. Ndi chosavuta, ndi chachangu, ndipo mungofunikira kuonetsetsa kuti mukuchita mosasintha. Chimene ndikufuna kuti muchite ndi kunena ziganizo zisanu mokweza, kwa inu nokha, tsiku lililonse. Ndizo zokha. Koma pali chinsinsi chaching'ono chimene chidzakuthandizani kuchisandutsa kukhala chizolowezi. Mukufunikira kusankha chiyambitso cha nthawi imene mudzanene ziganizo zanu. Chingathe kukhala chilichonse chimene mumachita tsiku ndi tsiku—anthu ambiri amasankha kunena ziganizo zawo pambuyo pochisempha mano, mwachitsanzo. Sankhani chinachake chimene mumachita tsiku lililonse, ndipo onetsetsani kuti mumanena ziganizo zanu mokweza pomwepo pambuyo pake—ndipo mu masabata pafupifupi awiri, chidzakhala chizolowezi kwa inu, choncho chidzangochitika chokha. Ndipo ngakhale chimawoneka ngati sitepe yaing'ono kwenikweni, kugwirizana kumene kudzakhala nako pa kuphunzira kwanu kudzakhala kwakukulu. Yesani, ndipo mudzaona. Tsopano, bwererani ku ntchito...

Kwa anthu ambiri, pamene ayamba kuchita ziganizo zawo za tsiku ndi tsiku za kulankhula mokweza, zikumveka zovuta kuganiza za chinena. Simufunikira kunena chinachake chovuta kwambiri—chofunika ndi kupanga chizolowezi—mudzanena mwachibadwa zinthu zitali ndi zochititsa chidwi kwambiri ubongo wanu ukazolowezereka kutulutsa chilankhulo chatsopano. Ngati mukuvutika kuganiza za chinena panopa, yambani ndi mawu asanu, ndipo nenanani chiganizo chimodzi pa chilichonse—ndikukulangizani kuyamba ndi Ndikufuna, Ndidzachita, Sindingathe, Ndikufunikira ndi koma. Mukapanga chizolowezi cha kunena chiganizo chimodzi mokweza tsiku lililonse pa chilichonse cha izi, posachedwa ubongo wanu udzayamba kupereka zina zothekera. Musadzikankhire kwambiri, mangopanga chizolowezi ndi ziganizo zosavuta, ndipo lolani ubongo wanu kuzolowezereka pang'onopang'ono, ndipo posachedwa mudzapeza kuti mukuyamba kunena zinthu zimene zidzakudabwitsani. Pampumulo wathu wotsatira, ndidzakuuzani pang'ono zambiri za ziyambitso za chizolowezi. Aa, ndipo ngati simunali ndi nthawi yozilemba, mawu asanu omwe ndikukulangizani kuti muyambe nawo kuchita ndi awa: Ndikufuna, Ndidzachita, Sindingathe, Ndikufunikira ndi koma. Ndikufuna, Ndidzachita, Sindingathe, Ndikufunikira ndi koma. Tsopano, bwererani ku ntchito.

Ndakuuzani kale momwe mungakhazikitsire chiyambitso cha chizolowezi—mumasankha chinachake chimene chimachitika tsiku lililonse, ndipo mumachigwiritsa ntchito ngati chikumbutso chanu kuchita kulankhula kwanu mokweza. Pali chinthu china chimodzi chomwe chimakuthandizani kumanga chizolowezi champhamvu kwenikweni, ndipo ndicho mphotho. Siziyenera kukhala mphotho yaikulu, makamaka osati ya chizolowezi cha tsiku ndi tsiku—koma ngati mungathe kuganiza za chinachake chimene mumachikonda kwenikweni, ndipo mudzipatse mphotho pambuyo pa gulu lililonse la ziganizo, mudzamanga chizolowezi champhamvu kwambiri. Mwina mungathe kugula phukusi la mabisiketi omwe mumakonda ndi kudya limodzi pambuyo pa gulu lililonse la ziganizo, kapena kusungira ndalama pambuyo pa gulu lililonse la ziganizo kuti mudzigulire mphotho yaikulu pambuyo pake—ganizani mwanzeru, pezani chinachake chimene chimayika kuseka pa nkhope yanu, ndipo mofulumira mudzakhala ndi chizolowezi champhamvu, chidzamveka chosavuta ndi chachibadwa, ndipo kulankhula kwanu kudzapitiriza kukhala bwino mofulumira kuposa ngati simunena ziganizo zanu. Ndipo mukamadziwira momwe mungamangire chizolowezi champhamvu, mungathe kugwiritsa ntchito tekinoloji yomweyo kumanga zizolowezi zina zatsopano ndi zofunika—ndidzakupatsani maganizo a zizolowezi zina zothandiza kwambiri za kuphunzira chilankhulo pambuyo pake.

Mwakhala mukuphunzira ndi App ya 'Say Something In' kwa nthawi yaitali tsopano—ndipo ndakuponyelani zambiri zatsopano. Nthawi ya kufotokoza mofulumira! Ubongo wanu uli ndi ma neurons pafupifupi 100 biliyoni—pafupifupi chiwerengero cha nyenyezi mu galaxy. Neuron iliyonse ili ndi pa chiwerengero pafupifupi 7000 malumikizidwe, choncho chiwerengero cha njira zomwe chizindikiro chingapite mu ubongo wanu ndi chopitirira chiwerengero cha ma atom mu chilengedwe. Ndipo ubongo wanu ukumanga ma synapses atsopano nthawi zonse—ungathe ngakhale kumanga nzeru zatsopano, kusandutsa zolowa za digito kukhala kuona ndi kumva, choncho ndithu ungathe kuphunzira chilankhulo. Zolakwika ndi nthawi ya kuyerekezera ndi kuzindikira kusiyana, ndipo ndi nthawi ya kuphunzira—mukamapanga zolakwika zambiri, mumaphunzira mofulumira. Ndipo mukamakhala pafupi kuphunzira mawu bwino, mumakhumudwa kwambiri mukasawapeza bwino—choncho kukhumudwa ndi khomo la kupambana. Ndipo pomaliza, lamulo la 10%—kudzikankhira pafupifupi 10% kunja kwa gawo lanu losangalala—ndi chinsinsi chofunika kwambiri cha kuphunzira mofulumira. Mwanjira ina, pogwira ntchito ndi App, mukuchita zinthu zonse zoyenera kuti mukwaniritse kupambana kwakukulu—choncho tiyeni tipitirize. Ndipo pampumulo wathu wotsatira, ndidzakuuzani momwe mungamve kunyadira kwambiri pa zimene mukupeza.

Kodi mukukumbukira pamene ndinakuuzani kuti ubongo wa munthu umayang'ana ku zoipa, chifukwa chinali chofunika kwambiri pa chipulumutso kuyang'ana nyama yoopsa kuposa chipatso chabwino? Njira imodzi imene izi zingachititse kuphunzira chilankhulo chatsopano kukhala kovuta kwa inu ndi yakuti ubongo wanu udzapitiriza kuyang'ana mawu atsopano omwe sunatsirize kuphunzira, m'malo mwa mawu onse ndi machitidwe omwe tsopano mungathe kunena mokhulupirira kwambiri. Mudzapeza kuti mudzaganiza pafupifupi nthawi zonse kuti muli ndi vuto ndi mawu atsopano ena—mudzayamba kudziuza kuti muyenera kuti munaphunzira kale—koma zokumbukira zimapangidwa pang'onopang'ono. Mudzatha kugwiritsa ntchito mawu atsopano pamene ubongo wanu watsiriza kupanga zokumbukira kwa iwo, kuchokera ku ndondomeko yopitirira ya kubwereza kosiyanitsa—choncho musadzidetse nkhawa ndi izo. Mawu aliwonse atsopano amafunikira kubwerezedwa, ndipo mawu ena atsopano amafunikira kubwerezedwa kwambiri kuposa ena—izi ndi zachibadwa, ndi zosapewereka, ndi momwe kukumbukira kumagwirira ntchito. Choncho musamve kuipa za mawu atsopano omwe ubongo wanu sunatsirize kuphunzira—mumve bwino kwambiri za mawu onse ena omwe ubongo wanu wayamba kutulutsa mofulumira ndi mosavuta, mawu omwe amawoneka osavuta ndi owonekera tsopano. Yang'anani ku zabwino! Tsopano, pitani ku ntchito...
